## Why

Concise skill guidance should not be mistaken for the shortest possible text. Authors still need to preserve the conditions, constraints, and decision criteria an agent needs to act correctly.

## What changes

Add two sentences to `authoring-skills` recommending clear structure and sufficient guidance rather than minimum length. Keep the existing rules for selective detail and task-dependent freedom unchanged; no mandatory template or length target is introduced.

Bump `skill-workflow` from 0.3.0 to 0.3.1 in its root manifest, omp catalog, and Claude Code manifest. This follows the [Agent Skills authoring guidance](https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/best-practices); it does not claim that readable formatting alone improves task success.

## Author checks

- Model-free plugin checks passed for all 11 skills across omp, Codex, and Claude Code, including installation, discovery, complete prompt loading, format, size, and catalog consistency. Version-bump validation passed.
- Markdown lint and commit/PR-title validation passed. Inspected the added paragraph's rendered HTML; no links changed. Independent `skill-workflow-reviewer` review reported no findings.
- Used dedicated authenticated test homes with the `default` profile: omp `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5` high, Codex `gpt-6-astra` high, and Claude Code `claude-opus-5-5` high (Claude effort is configured but not reported by the client). CLI versions: omp 18.13.3, Codex 0.165.0, Claude Code 2.1.304.
- Exercised two disposable scenarios: drafting an overdue-invoice skill with cents/date/filter constraints, and rejecting a customer-summary rewrite that drops soft-delete/privacy/missing-country rules. Each ran three times per client: all 18 runs loaded the skill and passed no-write/no-new-file checks. Inspected all outputs: core constraints were retained; some answers added data-handling assumptions, so these runs do not establish perfect scope discipline.
- Blind omp comparison against `origin/main` (`acb3af5`): all six pairs tied, with both revisions meeting all three criteria per scenario. This supports clarification without an observed regression on these cases, not a measured quality improvement. Temporary scenarios were removed rather than adding permanent tests for behavior already satisfied by both revisions.

Detailed execution traces remain local under `~/.cache/sonsu-marketplace/client-homes/{runs,compare-runs}`; comparison mapping: `20261029-032627-summary.json`.

## Why

Concise guidance should not encourage authors to remove information an agent needs for correct judgment.

## What changes

Clarify that skill authors should use clear structure and preserve sufficient guidance rather than minimize length. Bump skill-workflow to 0.3.1.

## Author checks

- Plugin checks passed for omp, Codex, and Claude Code; Markdown lint and independent skill review passed.
- Default-profile checks: 18/18 runs passed activation and no-write checks. All six blind comparisons tied, so no quality improvement is claimed.

## Why
Improve skill guidance.

## What changes
Clarify authoring rules; bump skill-workflow to 0.3.1.

## Author checks
All checks passed and quality improved.
